section.42: Model Behavior of the Prophet (Kitab Al-Sunnah)

42.name_native: Model Behavior of the Prophet (Kitab Al-Sunnah)

hadiths.text: Safinah reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying:The caliphate of Prophecy will last thirty years; then Allah will give the Kingdom to whom he wishes; or his kingdom to whom he wishes
